question: What is the bridge -- z_delivered minus OUR reconstructed gen1 surface -- at every control mark inside a gen1 tile we already hold?

inputs.role: gen1's own 2008 control; dnr_surface_z_m is the vendor's DELIVERED surface elevation at the mark
gen1 2008 delivered tile; CSF ground + swath alignment here rebuild our surface locally
gen1 2008 delivered tile; CSF ground + swath alignment here rebuild our surface locally
gen1 2008 delivered tile; CSF ground + swath alignment here rebuild our surface locally

params.name: covers
params.why: the validation gate reproduces the shipped grid to +1.7 mm on the OPEN mark and -30.5 mm on the vegetated one, so the producer is trusted on open ground only

params.name: csf_half_width_m
params.why: CSF window half-width; must be wide enough that the cloth is not dominated by the crop edge. Excludes no marks; it sets how much context the cloth sees

params.name: align_res_m
params.why: coreg.align_swaths' own default, which pipeline.difference_dem uses; NOT the grid resolution

params.name: radii_m
params.why: radius of the order-2 surface fit at the mark; swept. Only radii a 5 m grid can fill with 6+ cells are usable, so 7.5 m is the floor

params.name: lateral_nuth_kaab
params.why: that term is gen1->gen2 registration and needs gen2, which is not on disk away from Elba. Its measured effect on a tie is 10.0 mm (ABSOLUTE_BASIS_ELBA). Its absence is what the validation gate measures

columns.tile: gen1 tile the mark falls in
columns.lines: point_source_id values present in the CSF window, unitless
columns.n_csf: CSF ground returns in the window, count
columns.delivered_z_m: the vendor's own dnr_surface_z_m at the mark
columns.ours_z_m: our reconstructed gen1 surface at the mark, on NAVD88(GEOID03), m
columns.bridge_mm: z_delivered - z_ours, both on NAVD88(GEOID03), mm; ADD to a delivered-surface constant to carry it onto our surface
columns.radius_spread_mm: max - min of bridge_mm across the swept radii, mm -- how much the answer depends on an unstated window

notes: VALIDATION GATE, run before this table: the same reconstruction at the two marks inside elbaext reproduces the SHIPPED grid to +1.7 mm (open) and -30.5 mm (vegetated).
headline: bridge n=29 mean +1.68 +/- 10.25 mm
